decisions.hidden_reasoning:
I'm tracking the field state — Garchomp switched out for Rotom, so Rotom is now active and immune to Fake Out since it's part Ghost-type.

Weighing my options: Flare Blitz on Rotom is a safe neutral hit, or I could use Parting Shot to debuff Rotom and pivot to my own Garchomp, which resists Rotom's typing nicely since Electric is blocked by Ground. I'm also checking type matchups against the opponent's other threats like Gholdengo, confirming Steel doesn't resist Electric the way I initially assumed.

I'll go with Parting Shot — it weakens Rotom's offenses and sets up my Garchomp to come in cleanly for a Mega evolution next turn.

decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Both Garchomps are active, with the opponent's at -1 Atk and -1 SpA, possibly from Rough Skin or Sand Veil. I'm considering our Mega Garchomp with Sand Force boosting Earthquake's 170 Atk against the opposing Garchomp, since Ground-type moves hit Dragon/Ground normally with no immunity.

Dragon Claw actually looks like the stronger option -- STAB plus the 2x weakness Dragon types have to Dragon moves means it outdamages Earthquake's neutral hit. I'm also double-checking whether Stone Edge would be super effective here, though the earlier log suggested otherwise, so I'll set that aside and lean toward Dragon Claw as the better STAB attack given Mega Garchomp's massive Attack stat.
